currency.basis: The tick mark is Sber's brand identity since 2020 and remains in current official use, observed live on 2026-10-03 in the official SberBusiness icon set and developer documentation.

identity.basis: The Sber tick (open ring with check entering upper right) is the current Sber brand mark used for СберБизнес, confirmed by the official SberBusiness/icons repository and Sber developer styleguide.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official provenance (SberBusiness GitHub organization and developers.sber.ru) is one official group; the Wikimedia copy is an independent third-party corroboration of the official color and period, with its source cited back to sberbank.ru.
uncertainties: sberbank.ru itself is behind a government-CA/WAF barrier for this environment, so the live landing page was not rendered; currency rests on the official SberBusiness organization assets and developer documentation.

The official glyph retrieved is the monochrome light-theme variant; Sber's full-color gradient presentation exists in the lockup source, but recoloring the emblem is not permitted, so the candidate keeps the official monochrome artwork on transparency.

variant.basis: Standalone tick glyph without accompanying text, supplied by the official brand icon set as a first-class brand icon; suitable as a standalone catalog mark. The full-color gradient lockup variant was rejected due to the accompanying wordmark.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All contours, gradient stops (including the exact official Sber green rgb(12.94%,62.75%,21.96%) = #21A038) and internal transparency of the lockup's tick artwork survive verbatim; the check and seven ring segments match the source raster exactly in the source/final comparison on both themes.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The standalone tick occupies the full source emblem proportions on a transparent field; no backing was added and no whole-emblem transform beyond the original canvas was applied. Complete fit with clear margins at 240px, recognizable at 32px on both themes; no clipping or detail loss.
candidate.rationale: Replaces the accepted icon's segment-drawn tick in non-official teal (#3a7d8a circle) with the official Sber tick artwork in official gradient colors — a documented color/geometry correction for the same current symbol, with the lockup's wordmark omitted per the catalog rule against accompanying bank names.
candidate.role: catalog standalone brand mark on transparency
transforms: Verbatim extraction of the standalone tick mark (check path + seven ring-segment paths with their six linearGradient definitions) from the fetched official-design 2020 lockup SVG (302x50, Commons copy citing Source=sberbank.ru); paths, paint and gradient definitions copied unchanged, no scaling, no recoloring; lockup wordmark paths omitted under the catalog suitability rule.
Viewbox set to 0 0 47 48 around the extracted emblem bounds (emblem x 0.14-46.44, y 0.41-47.22); emblem geometry and paint untouched.

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e0...), multipass: 5850 -> 3742 bytes; optimized version selected (visually identical to working version on both themes at 240px, confirmed by model image comparison of rsvg-convert renders).
candidate.variant: official Sber 2020 gradient tick mark, standalone symbol variant (lockup text excluded)
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon is a white segment-drawn tick on a non-official teal circle; candidate is the official tick geometry with official multicolor gradient on transparency — visibly different geometry, palette and presentation.

proposals.reason: Accepted icon (sha256 c8335779...) shows the correct current Sber tick symbol but in a non-official teal (#3a7d8a) circle with white strokes, and a segment-drawn ring rather than the official glyph. The current СберБизнес identity uses the official Sber tick mark; an official original-vector tick glyph was retrieved from the official SberBusiness/icons repository and is proposed as a candidate replacement (standalone mark on transparency).

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original-vector Sber tick glyph from the official SberBusiness icon repository; replaces the accepted icon's segment-drawn, non-official-color rendition of the same mark with the official geometry, a supported color/geometry correction.

sources.observation: Official SberBusiness/icons repository brand icon set: standalone Sber tick glyph as two paths, monochrome #1F1F22 light-theme variant (dark-theme sibling _dm_w exists); retrieved live with receipt.
Official Sber developer styleguide confirming the current Sber tick brand symbol and its official green palette usage.

Wikimedia Commons copy of the 2020 Sberbank logo lockup, file page citing Source=sberbank.ru 'Sberbank logo since 2020'; its gradient stops contain the exact official Sber green #21A038, confirming the accepted icon's #3a7d8a teal is non-official. The lockup itself (tick + wordmark) was rejected for catalog use because of the accompanying name.
